evidence.title: Myanmar's military-backed leader turns to diplomacy on Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: Global New Light of Myanmar report and U.S.-Myanmar diplomatic records
occurrences.quote_span: Myanmar’s state-run Global New Light of Myanmar suggested the decision was made to curry favor and maintain friendly relations with Washington.
occurrences.speaker: Global New Light of Myanmar
occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: official itinerary and meeting records from the Malaysian Prime Minister's Office
occurrences.quote_span: Myanmar’s military-backed leader pressed on with his pivot to diplomacy on a visit to Malaysia, his first since becoming president earlier this year, holding talks Thursday with the country’s prime minister and other officials in an effort to boost ties.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: Min Aung Hlaing's official travel records and Myanmar government records
occurrences.quote_span: Min Aung Hlaing earlier visited Laos, Thailand, Vietnam and Cambodia in attempts to rebuild regional ties that deteriorated after he ousted Aung San Suu Kyi’s government in February 2021 while serving as army chief.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: Anwar Ibrahim's public statements and Malaysia repatriation policy records
occurrences.quote_span: Malaysia’s prime minister has defended the repatriation policy, saying his country cannot host the undocumented foreign nationals indefinitely and that Myanmar must take responsibility for its citizens.
occurrences.speaker: Anwar Ibrahim
occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: Malaysia-Myanmar bilateral trade statistics
occurrences.quote_span: Anwar said bilateral trade had increased by more than 140% year-on-year, while Min Aung Hlaing said Malaysia was Myanmar’s fourth-largest trading partner and ninth-largest investor.
occurrences.speaker: Anwar Ibrahim
occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: Min Aung Hlaing's official foreign-visit records
occurrences.quote_span: The visit was also Min Aung Hlaing’s fifth to a fellow ASEAN member.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: Khoo Ying Hooi's statement and ASEAN policy documents
occurrences.quote_span: “There’s a serious contradiction here,” she said. “ASEAN continues to demand progress to end the violence but their collective pressure is already weakened” with bilateral engagement focusing on economic cooperation.
occurrences.speaker: Khoo Ying Hooi
occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: ASEAN summit attendance records and Myanmar military takeover records
occurrences.quote_span: Critics and analysts say expanding bilateral engagement could gradually normalize his government’s regional standing — even as ASEAN blocks Myanmar from top-level meetings since the country’s 2021 military takeover that triggered an armed resistance.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: UNHCR Malaysia refugee and asylum-seeker registration data
occurrences.quote_span: Malaysia is home to about 215,600 refugees and asylum-seekers registered with UNHCR, including about 126,000 Rohingya who make up one of Southeast Asia’s largest refugee communities.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: Myanmar government repatriation commitments and naval deployment records
occurrences.quote_span: Min Aung Hlaing promised to expedite the process and send a naval vessel to Malaysia to assist with further repatriations.
occurrences.speaker: Min Aung Hlaing
occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: MRTV evening news broadcast archive
occurrences.quote_span: After landing in Kuala Lumpur on Wednesday, Min Aung Hlaing sought to reassure Malaysian investors that Myanmar was on a path toward democracy and that his government was working to restore stability, state-run MRTV television reported in its evening news program.
occurrences.speaker: MRTV television
occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: UNHCR statements and rights-group reports on the repatriations
occurrences.quote_span: The United Nations refugee agency and rights groups have slammed the repatriations, saying that the security and humanitarian situation in parts of Myanmar remains volatile, and returnees could face persecution and forced military conscription in an active war zone.

occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: Kuala Lumpur protest records and rights-group statements
occurrences.quote_span: Inside a Kuala Lumpur building on Thursday, a few dozen people gathered as rights groups held a protest against the visit.

occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: U.N. treaty status records and Malaysian immigration law
occurrences.quote_span: Despite hosting them, Malaysia isn’t a party to the U.N. Refugee Convention and treats refugees as undocumented migrants.

occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: Malaysian government statements on Min Aung Hlaing's visit
occurrences.quote_span: Malaysia has stressed that inviting Min Aung Hlaing, who became president in April following a much-criticized election, does not amount to diplomatic recognition of Myanmar’s government.
occurrences.speaker: Malaysia government
occurrences.subject: Min Aung Hlaing's Malaysia visit

occurrences.checkable_against: Myanmar citizenship records and reports on Rohingya persecution
